Yahweh was with Jehoshaphat, because he walked in the first ways of his father David, and didn’t seek the Baals,
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, according to all that David his father had done.
and tore the kingdom away from David’s house, and gave it you; and yet you have not been as my servant David, who kept…
because David did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and didn’t turn away from anything that he commanded him all…
He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in all the way of David his father, and didn’t turn away to…
You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
According to the decisions of the law which they shall teach you, and according to the judgment which they shall tell…
that his heart not be lifted up above his brothers, and that he not turn away from the commandment to the right hand…
and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after…
Only be strong and very courageous. Be careful to observe to do according to all the law which Moses my servant…
“Therefore be very courageous to keep and to do all that is written in the book of the law of Moses, that you not turn…

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: He did that which was right in Yahweh’s eyes, and walked in the ways of David his father, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left.
translations.bsb: And he did what was right in the eyes of the LORD and walked in the ways of his father David; he did not turn aside to the right or to the left.
translations.kjv: And he did that which was right in the sight of the LORD, and walked in the ways of David his father, and declined neither to the right hand, nor to the left.
translations.asv: And he did that which was right in the eyes of Jehovah, and walked in the ways of David his father, and turned not aside to the right hand or to the left.
